meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: Claude 会先探测本地已有的 Mattermost 服务器,让你选用、另填 URL 或自建评估服务器;随后安装频道适配器,配置 bot 令牌与审批回调密钥,把 Mattermost 私信、频道、话题等接入。
howto.when: 当你要求添加 Mattermost 渠道或机器人时接管:它先探测 localhost:8065 等本地服务器,再让你选择使用、另填 URL 或创建本地评估服务器。

say.text: 帮我添加 Mattermost 机器人渠道
say.note: 会先探测本地服务器再让你选择

say.text: 就用 https://mattermost.example.com 这个服务器
say.note: 会校验并设为 base URL

say.text: 创建一个本地评估用的 Mattermost 服务器
say.note: 需要 Docker,且 8065 端口空闲

howto.what_en: Claude probes for an existing Mattermost server, lets you pick it, enter another URL, or create a local evaluation server, then installs the channel adapter and configures the bot token and callback secret.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Mattermost channel or bot; it probes local servers such as localhost:8065, then asks you to use one, enter another URL, or create a local evaluation server.

say_en.note: It probes local servers first, then lets you choose
Verifies and sets it as the base URL

say_en.text: Create a local evaluation Mattermost server
say_en.note: Needs Docker and a free port 8065
